tldr: Mars in the 2nd house routes drive and action through livelihood and value.
body: With Mars in the 2nd house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through money, resources, values, possessions, and self-worth. This makes how you earn, hold, spend, and define what is worth protecting a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through livelihood and value.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in livelihood and value.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
